# Jonny Aaronson — Aaronson Motion

> Jonathan (Jonny) Aaronson is a Senior Motion Designer, Video Editor and UX Designer based in the Boston, MA area, working as Aaronson Motion since 2008. His work spans 2D/3D animation, motion graphics, visual effects, video editing, storyboarding and UX design for film/TV, marketing, education, healthcare, gaming and web clients. His video and animation work has appeared at the Grand Ole Opry in Nashville and on the Nasdaq Tower in Times Square, and at professional sporting events, including New York Mets and Nashville Predators games, and at large conferences. He holds a B.S. in Media Arts & Animation and a certificate in UX Design, and has taught motion design as a professor.

Last updated: 2026-11-20

## Work

- [Home](https://aaronsonmotion.com/): Demo reel, services and the clients he has worked with.
- [Motion Design](https://aaronsonmotion.com/motion-design.html): Promos, ads, explainers, logo and title animation, social media, courses and animated GIFs.
- [VFX & Video Editing](https://aaronsonmotion.com/vfx-video-editing.html): Visual effects and video editing work.
- [Design](https://aaronsonmotion.com/design.html): Overview of the design work: UX, storyboards, 2D and 3D design, line drawings and fine art.
- [UX Design](https://aaronsonmotion.com/ux-design.html): Case studies: Design to Motion (D2M), SkiPS, AutoExpreso, Navient.com and OpenToon.
- [2D Design](https://aaronsonmotion.com/2d-design.html): Logos, t-shirt designs, album art, game art and print.
- [3D Design](https://aaronsonmotion.com/3d-design.html): 3D modeling, lighting and rendering.
- [Storyboards](https://aaronsonmotion.com/storyboards.html): Storyboards and animatic boards for conference, promo and explainer videos.
- [Line Drawings](https://aaronsonmotion.com/line-drawings.html): Technical drawings of light fixtures and housings, and architectural pre-construction drawings.
- [Fine Art](https://aaronsonmotion.com/fine-art.html): Drawings and figure studies.
- [About](https://aaronsonmotion.com/about.html): Bio, background and a fantasy-themed stat sheet.
- [Now](https://aaronsonmotion.com/now.html): What Jonny has been doing lately.
- [Resume](https://aaronsonmotion.com/resume.html): Experience, skills and software, with PDF and Word downloads.
